scenes.title: Announcing the Drought
scenes.english_text: Long ago, a brave prophet of God named Elijah stood before the wicked King Ahab. Because the king and his people were worshiping false idols, Elijah boldly declared, 'As the Lord lives, there will be no rain or dew for years until I call for it!' Then God sent Elijah away to hide safely.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha tempu uluk, profeta brani Maromak nian naran Elias hamriik iha Liurai aat Acab nia oin. Tanba liurai no nia povu adora ídolu falsu sira, Elias deklara ho brani, 'Nu'udar Na'i moris, sei la iha uan ka bee-wain ba tinan barak to'o ha'u bolu fali!' Tuir mai Maromak haruka Elias ba subar ho seguru.
scenes.scene_summary: Elijah boldly confronts King Ahab and announces a severe drought because of Israel's idolatry.

scenes.title: Fed by Ravens at Cherith
scenes.english_text: God led Elijah to hide by the quiet Cherith Ravine, where he could drink fresh water from the brook. Every morning and every evening, God sent black ravens carrying bread and meat to feed Elijah. God faithfully took care of His prophet in the desert.
scenes.tetum_translation: Maromak lori Elias ba subar iha Mota-Klean Cherith, ne'ebé nia bele hemu bee moos husi mota. Dader-dader no kalan-kalan, Maromak haruka manu-metan sira lori paung no na'an atu fó han Elias. Maromak tau matan ho laran-metin ba Nia profeta iha rai-maran.
scenes.scene_summary: God miraculously sends ravens to bring bread and meat to Elijah by the Cherith Ravine.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a bearded Hebrew prophet wearing a brown woolen cloak sitting by a sparkling blue stream, reaching up happily as black ravens fly down holding bread in their beaks. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: The Widow of Zarephath
scenes.english_text: When the brook dried up, God sent Elijah to the town of Zarephath to stay with a poor widow. She had only a small handful of flour and a few drops of oil left. But because she shared her last meal with Elijah, God miraculously kept her flour jar and oil jug full until the drought ended.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira mota maran tiha, Maromak haruka Elias ba vila Sarepta atu hela ho faluk ki'ak ida. Nia iha de'it trigu liman-fulan ida no mina oituan tebes. Maibé tanba nia fahe nia aihan ikus ho Elias, Maromak halo milagre hodi halo nia trigu-pote no mina-kuru nakonu nafatin to'o uan mós mosu.
scenes.scene_summary: God multiplies the flour and oil for the widow of Zarephath when she kindly shares food with Elijah.

scenes.title: Fire from Heaven on Mount Carmel
scenes.english_text: On Mount Carmel, Elijah challenged 450 false prophets of Baal to see who was the true God. The false prophets shouted all day, but nothing happened. Then Elijah built a stone altar, poured water over it, and prayed. Instantly, God sent fire down from heaven, consuming the sacrifice, stones, and water!
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha Foho Carmelo, Elias desafia profeta falsu 450 Baal nian atu haree sé mak Maromak loloos. Profeta falsu sira hakilar loron tomak, maibé buat ida la mosu. Tuir mai Elias harii altár fatuk, fui bee ba leten, no harohan. Derrepente, Maromak haruka ahi tun husi lalehan, han tiha sakrifísiu, fatuk, no bee hotu!
scenes.scene_summary: God answers Elijah's prayer on Mount Carmel by sending fire from heaven to consume the wet sacrifice.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, the prophet Elijah standing with arms raised beside a stone altar wet with water, as a brilliant column of heavenly fire comes down from sky under dramatic clouds. scenes.title: The Still Small Voice on Mount Horeb
scenes.english_text: When wicked Queen Jezebel threatened Elijah, he ran to Mount Horeb feeling tired and alone. A mighty wind, an earthquake, and a roaring fire passed by, but God was not in them. Afterwards came a gentle, still small voice. God spoke softly, comforting Elijah and showing him he was never alone.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Liurai-Feto aat Jezabel menace Elias, nia halai ba Foho Horeb no sente kole no mesak. Anin boot, rai-sodur, no ahi lakan liu ba, maibé Maromak la iha sira-nia laran. Tuir mai mosu lian kmaan no nonook. Maromak ko'alia kmaan, fó ksolok ba Elias no hatudu katak nia la mesak duni.
scenes.scene_summary: Exhausted Elijah encounters God not in wind, earthquake, or fire, but in a still, gentle whisper at Mount Horeb.

Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Rebuking Ahab's Greed
scenes.english_text: King Ahab coveted Naboth's vineyard, and Queen Jezebel used lies to take it. When Ahab went to claim the garden, Elijah met him boldly and declared God's righteous judgment against their greed and cruelty. Elijah showed that God protects the weak and sees all injustice.
scenes.tetum_translation: Liurai Acab hakarak tebes Nabot nia ai-voti laran, no Liurai-Feto Jezabel uzu bosok atu foti ne'e. Bainhira Acab ba foti garden ne'e, Elias hasoru nia ho brani no deklara Maromak nia tesi-lia loos kontra sira-nia laran-ka'it no cruel. Elias hatudu katak Maromak proteje ema kbiit-laek no haree injustisa hotu.
scenes.scene_summary: Elijah boldly confronts King Ahab in Naboth's vineyard to denounce greed and injustice.

scenes.title: Passing the Mantle to Elisha
scenes.english_text: As Elijah's time on earth drew near, his loyal disciple Elisha stayed by his side. Elisha asked, 'Please let a double portion of your spirit be upon me!' Elijah placed his prophet's cloak upon Elisha, passing on God's holy calling to the next generation.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Elias nia tempu iha rai besik atu ramata, nia eskolante laran-metin Eliseu hela iha nia sorin. Eliseu husu, 'Fó ha'u simu espiritual nian dala rua husi ó!' Elias tau nia hena-kapa profeta nian ba Eliseu nia kabas, hodi entrega Maromak nia bolu santu ba jerasaun tuir mai.
scenes.scene_summary: Elijah passes his prophet cloak mantle to his faithful young disciple Elisha.

scenes.title: Taken to Heaven in a Chariot of Fire
scenes.english_text: Suddenly, a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared, separating Elijah and Elisha. Elijah was carried up into heaven by a mighty whirlwind without experiencing death! Elisha picked up Elijah's cloak and praised God for the great prophet's life.
scenes.tetum_translation: Derrepente, kuda-karreta ahi nian no kuda ahi nian mosu, hodi fahe Elias no Eliseu. Elias hetan foti sa'e ba lalehan husi anin-fultun boot tanpa sente mate! Eliseu foti Elias nia hena-kapa no hahi'i Maromak ba profeta boot ne'e nia moris.
scenes.scene_summary: Elijah is taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire and a whirlwind as Elisha watches in awe.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Elijah teaches us to stand boldly for God alone and listen quietly to His gentle voice when we feel tired or afraid.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Elias hanorin ita atu hamriik ho brani ba Maromak mesak no rona ho nonook Nia lian kmaan bainhira ita kole ka ta'uk.
reflection.discussion_question_en: When you feel alone or overwhelmed this week, how can you spend quiet time listening to God's voice in prayer?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Bainhira ó sente mesak ka susar iha semana ne'e, oinsá ó bele gasta tempu nonook atu rona Maromak nia lian iha orasaun?
